chunks: God and His angels shower their blessings on the Prophet. O believers, you should also send your blessings on him, and salute him with a worthy greeting.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Yusalluna' in the context of God and angels blessing the Prophet?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Ahzab (33:56) establishes the divine precedent for sending blessings (salat) upon the Prophet Muhammad, noting that both God and His angels do so. It then commands the believers to follow this example by sending their own blessings and salutations upon him. In Shia scholarship, this is often linked to the concept of 'Al-Salat al-Nabawiyya' as a means of spiritual connection and intercession, emphasizing the Prophet's unique status as the perfect human (al-Insan al-Kamil).
